coordinateConvention: Zero-based absolute source pixels. Geometric height=bottomY-topY; inclusive occupancy adds the endpoint pixel. Adaptive sourceRegion records complete parcels crossing nominal 418px cuts. Source pixels unchanged.

groundPlaneEstimate.method: Robust alpha>128 foreground bottom-contour fits with 95th-percentile positive residual locating post feet below raised rails. Opposite side midpoint defines ground datum; hidden back vertex is unobserved.
